source.provider: Mapzen / AWS Open Data terrain tiles
source.note: Global compiled visualization elevation; source resolutions and dates vary. Not INEGI high-resolution DTM. Native vertical reference not independently verified.
source.attribution: Mapzen terrain tiles; underlying source attribution varies by tile; AWS Open Data terrain-tiles registry.

demSampling.method: bilinear interpolation from decoded Terrarium pixels at geographic grid cell centers
demSampling.horizontalDistance: spherical metric approximation; cellSizeX fixed at domain center latitude

domainNote: Broad provisional metropolitan acquisition rectangle. Not an official municipal union, not a delineated catchment. Outside inflows ignored by bounded-domain routing. Regional demonstration resolution does not resolve streets, buildings, culverts or storm sewers.
